note: The ratchet of `pnpm check:coverage` (DEC-0141). `max` is the worst tally this repository is allowed to have. A run worse than a number here fails; a run better than one fails too, asking for the number to be lowered in the same commit, so that a gain is recorded instead of left as budget to spend again. Raising a number is a governance change: it needs a decision record, and the record says which criteria were let go and why.
measured_on: T-19, the test-alignment sweep (DEC-0144). MISSING 145 -> 136 and NAMED ONLY 32 -> 29, with no raise. Nine criteria gained an instrument and three moved off NAMED ONLY, all of them criteria that were already being enforced and could not be attributed: TS-WEB-0017-A2/A7/A17/A19 and TS-WEB-0017-A4/A5/A6 because check-stack.ts and check-brand.ts prefixed their failure messages with a bare `A2`/`A19` and the report line pasted `TS-017-` in front of it, which is no identifier this repository defines, so the meters were METERED for nothing; TS-WEB-0013-A4 with a static test that parses TS-WEB-0013 D2 out of the specification and compares it with the CSP allowlist (three divergences declared, see DEC-0144); TS-WEB-0002-A9 with e2e/reduced-motion.spec.ts; TS-WEB-0003-A7 as METERED on the CI job that runs the CLS observer, its level being `tool`; TS-WEB-0017-A8/A9 and TS-WEB-0017-A12 by walking every route instead of `/` alone; TS-WEB-0018-A12 with an integration test of the whole chain from a stubbed-empty stats upstream to the rendered band. One title lost an identifier rather than gaining one: src/lib/analytics/call-sites.test.ts claimed TS-WEB-0012-A2, an `e2e` criterion about cookies and hosts that a source scan cannot observe; A2 stays VERIFIED through e2e/privacy.spec.ts, which is its real instrument, so the removal costs no coverage and removes a false one.
